title: Cookie banner appears after reload
body:
## Steps
- accept cookies / do not accept cookies
- reload the page

## current
- cookie banner appears

## expected
- browser recognizes, that the user has chosen, as long as the user doesn't clear cookies

## Related issue 
#420
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: I don't think we should do this until we have a button or something that lets us show the banner again. This is because apparently ["GDPR requires that the consent provided for the collection, processing, storing of data is reversible"](https://www.cookieyes.com/change-cookie-consent-using-cookieyes).

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
I cannot reproduce this error on try.tgrade.finance - so it actually works :D

We only have a paid account for try. and just "misuse" the cookie banner on the staging environment. Hence it only sets cookie on try. and not on staging and hence you experience this issue on staging. (and FYI: there is no "disable appear after reload" option).

The banner can be located on different places on the screen so that it doesn't cover key functionality.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
I just deployed the latest version of the code to [dapp.tgrade.finance](https://dapp.tgrade.finance) in order to check the functionality of the cookie banner, the cookies button, and the correct storage of Google Analytics' cookies.

I have tested that:
- The cookie banner does not show on reload.
- The cookie banner can be shown if the user clicks on the Cookies button.
- The Google Analytics cookies get stored or deleted depending on the user accepting or rejecting, and this can be modified as many times as desired by using the Cookies button.

comments.body:
- [x] The cookie banner does not show on reload after Accepting it once
- [x] The cookie banner does not show on reload after Rejecting it once
- [x] The cookie banner can be shown if the user clicks on the “Cookies” button
- [x] The Google Analytics cookies get stored or deleted depending on the user accepting or rejecting, and this can be modified as many times as desired by using the Cookies button.


- [x] Chrome ✅ 
- [x] Firefox ✅ 
- [ ] Safari 🔴
